verses.1: David went from there, and he went to the cave of Adullam. His brothers and all the houses of his father’s family heard about it. They rushed to meet him there.
verses.2: And all those who were sick, and all those who had lost their strength, came to him. There were about four thousand people with him.
verses.3: And David went from there to Moab. He said to King Moab, “Please let my father and mother come with me. I want to know what God will do to me.”
verses.4: And he comforted the face of King Moab. All the days that David remained there, they sat with him there.
verses.5: And the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not settle in Jerusalem. Instead, go and settle in the land of Judah.” So David went and arrived at the forest of Haret.
verses.6: Shaul heard that David and his men were there. Shaul was sitting under the tree, with his spear in hand. All his servants stood around him.
verses.7: And Shaul said to his servants who were standing around him, “Listen! My sons will give you fields and vineyards. I will also give you thousands of servants and hundreds of overseers.”
verses.8: For you all have clung to me, and no one can turn my ears away from the deeds of my children with their sons. None of you can get rid of me, because my children have built their gods upon me, so that they may rule over me today.
verses.9: And the village was in chaos. It stood on the land of Shaul’s servants. He said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming down to Ahijmelach, the son of Achituv.”
verses.10: And Jehovah asked him for it. He gave him Zida, and also gave him the branches of the Philistine tree.
verses.11: And the king sent for Ahimelech, son of Ahijah, the priest, and all the family of his father’s priests who lived in Nob. They all came before the king.
verses.12: And Shaul said, “Shma’nah, son of Achituv.” And he said, “I am Adonai.”
verses.13: And Shaul said to him, “Why do you tie me up? You and your son Ishai give him bread and meat. But Shaul asked God to rise up against me on this day.”
verses.14: And Ahimelech answered the king, “Who among your servants is as David? He is true and loyal. He will go to your palace and be killed there.”
verses.15: Today, I began to ask God for help. Please do not let the king act in accordance with his own will in every household of my father. For your servant does not know anything about these matters, whether they are small or important.
verses.16: And the king said, “Mortal, you and all your family will die.”
verses.17: And the king said to those who were standing against him, “Kill them! These are priests of Yahweh. Their hands are tied together with David’s hands. They know that he has escaped, and they have not told me anything. They also did not send out his men to harm the priests of Yahweh.”
verses.18: And the king said to Doeg, “You, go and harm the priests.” Doeg obeyed and harmed the priests. He died on that same day. And five men were also killed in that incident.
verses.19: And the city of the priests was destroyed by fire, from man to woman, from child to old man, from young man to old woman. It was destroyed completely by fire.
verses.20: And one of the sons was taken captive to Achimelek. His name was Ebyatar. He ran away after David.
verses.21: And Ebyatar told David that Shaul had killed the priests of Jehovah.
verses.22: And David said to Abiatar, “I know that on that day, the house will be destroyed. For I will tell Shaul that I am your daughter, with all my heart. I am the daughter of your father.”
verses.23: Sit with me, do not fear. For whatever I seek for my soul, you will also seek for your soul. For you are the one who will keep me safe.
